title: carduncellus pinnatus subsp. matritensis
intro: Carduncellus pinnatus subsp. matritensis, commonly known as Spanish artichoke, is a plant species belonging to the Cynara genus, native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the regulation of blood pressure, improvement of digestive health, and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Carduncellus pinnatus subsp. matritensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cynarin, inulin, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
